name: Tenter Row, the back lane and Kett's granary
region: Andorhal granary district, off Hurdle Lane on the right; Kett's at the bottom, reached by a back lane

sensoryProfile.sight: Tenter Row: narrow, straight for a stretch then bends left; dyers' yards on either side with the day's cloth hung on tenter frames, blue and rust-red, slack in still air; dust thick at the edges of the cobbles that shows prints; over the bend a granary gable and a hoist beam with no rope on it. The back lane beyond: long, straight, loading doors along both sides shut and barred, cobbles white with dust, a lamp at each end, no doorway deep enough to stand in. Kett's: smaller and older than Fenner's, stone below and black timber above, hoist beam bare, last door on the left of the back lane. Upper floor: a row of small windows on the lane side, panes thick with dust and cobweb, a lot of lamplight; the bottom pane of the nearest knocked out for air, giving a view of half the loft floor.
sensoryProfile.sound: A woman singing a child the same flat line on the roofs; the Exchange bell; axles.
sensoryProfile.smell: Sour stink of the dye vats.
sensoryProfile.touch: Roof grit and chimney soot; one stack warm from somebody's supper fire.
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: Good tailing ground only from above: no cover in the lane, plenty on the roofs.

establishedFacts.fact: Kett's is a small granary Havel 'left out at the post' and said had shut its gate at noon ('You'll get nothing there tonight'). It runs a lit night shift in its upper floor: five masked workers, a crock of dark thick stuff, open sacks stencilled with the sheaf in a ring and ANDORHAL, a stack of sewn sacks by the stair, gloves in a bucket, a basin to wash.

Kett's bills (Corin): every bill on Kett's mark is for the first carts out, the south road and weir road; Kett keeps nothing overnight. At the post Lyriel counts seven loaded carts gone down the lane toward the south and one empty coming up.
The loft door on the lane side has a hasp, a long iron one; the inspection office's tag will not open it (Corin knows the kind of lock).

Approach for Sylvanas's tail: Hurdle Lane to Tenter Row, round the bend, a wider street with a wagon going down toward the weir (she keeps the wheels between her and the runner), left into the back lane; water butt and lean-to at the near corner for the roof climb; roofs run together with hardly a step; a chimney stack across from Kett's is her vantage.

Capture plan positions: Cyndia on the roofs over the back lane by the chimney across from the loft; Lyriel at the bend in Tenter Row; Havel's lads at the Hurdle Lane end; Sylvanas, Jaina and Corin go in; Sylvanas expects 'one man coming and going alone through that door'.

eventsHere.event: Sylvanas watches five masked men at work in the loft; a grit slide brings a man to the window; the bell sounds and she retreats.
